title: OL-20261115-24: site/*.test.mjs are not run by the checks workflow
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** next change to .github/workflows/checks.yml
**Done check:** grep:.github/workflows/checks.yml::site/.*test.mjs
**Status:** open

checks.yml only runs node --check over site/*.js; site tests (controlplane, forward, connections, oauth...) run only in sessions. Add a step running them (protected path: workflow change). Session: session_0156nqDt4ontnhzSFvT4PTB8
